name: Punishing Children
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of honoring parents as a foundation for a blessed life, while also affirming the necessity of disciplined correction in child-rearing. The Bible teaches that a loving parent does not withhold correction, using the rod as a means to remove foolishness and guide a child toward righteousness. Early and consistent training in the ways of the Lord ensures that a child will remain steadfast in godly paths throughout life. Even in cases of rebellion, discipline is portrayed as a vital tool for restoring obedience and hope.
